title: node --input-type=module -e 'import {createRequire} from "node:module"; import {readFile} from "node:fs/promises"; import {buildAcpDiff,verifyAcpDiff} from "./scripts/lib/acp-contract.mjs"; const req=createRequire(import.meta.url); const paths=[["protocol/acp/v1/schema.json","@agentclientprotocol/sdk/schema/schema.json"],["protocol/acp/v2-preview/schema.json","@agentclientprotocol/sdk/schema/v2/schema.unstable.json"]]; console.log("BYTE_MATCHES="+(await Promise.all(paths.map(async ([repo,pkg])=>(await readFile(repo)).equals(await readFile(req.resolve(pkg)))))).join(",")); const [v1,v2]=await Promise.all(paths.map(async ([,pkg])=>JSON.parse(await readFile(req.resolve(pkg),"utf8")))); const diff=buildAcpDiff(v1,v2); const c=JSON.parse(await readFile("protocol/acp/change-classifications.json","utf8")); const s=structuredClone(c); s.reviewedSets.structural.namesSha256="0".repeat(64); let sf=false; try{verifyAcpDiff(diff,s)}catch{sf=true}; const q=structuredClone(c); delete q.requiredChanges.ContentChunk; let rf=false; try{verifyAcpDiff(diff,q)}catch{rf=true}; console.log(JSON.stringify({common:diff.definitionSets.commonCount,summary:diff.commonDefinitions.summary,structuralFailClosed:sf,requiredFailClosed:rf}));'
